basic_details.job_title: Telangana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 433 Anganwadi Helper & Worker Posts in Kumuram Bheem Asifabad District

age_limit.details: Applicants must be between 35 years and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026. (Note: The official notification specifies a range of 35 years to 35 years).

qualification.details: The applicant must be a female local resident. For urban areas, the candidate must reside in the concerned ward. For rural areas, the candidate must reside in the concerned Gram Panchayat. | As per SC/ST sub-plan, posts reserved for SC habitations are open only to SC candidates belonging to that village panchayat (SC Earmark). As per SC/ST sub-plan, posts reserved for ST habitations are open only to ST candidates belonging to that hamlet / habitation (ST Earmark).

selection_process: The selection process comprises merit marks
and an interview conducted by the District Selection Committee.
Intermediate / 12th Class marks - Maximum merit marks: 70 marks. Special Categories: Widows - 5 marks. Orphans (JJ Act

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at wdcw.tg.nic.in.
Navigate to the online application link for the Kumuram Bheem Asifabad district recruitment.
Register and fill out the online application form with required details.
Upload scanned copies of all required documents.
Submit the application form before 5:00 PM on 23 October 2026.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications submitted through DWO, CDPO, Prajavani, post, or e-mail will not be considered. Only online applications submitted through the official portal will be accepted. The District Collector and District Magistrate / Collector, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad reserves full rights to cancel, modify, or alter the notification or decisions without assigning reasons. Candidates belonging to SC Group-I, Group-II, and Group-III who previously applied for Group-III reserves need not apply again as per POA.A2 memo dated 14.04.2025; they will be considered automatically, while remaining SC group applicants must submit applications online. Printed copies of the application must be submitted to the respective Gram Panchayat / Mandal offices / Division offices notice board.

WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Vacancy Details (Project-wise)
content_sections.text: The notification announces a total of 433 vacancies distributed across various project mandals and posts.

content_sections.heading: WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a female local resident. For urban areas, the candidate must reside in the concerned ward. For rural areas, the candidate must reside in the concerned Gram Panchayat. As per SC/ST sub-plan, posts reserved for SC habitations are open only to SC candidates belonging to that village panchayat (SC Earmark). As per SC/ST sub-plan, posts reserved for ST habitations are open only to ST candidates belonging to that hamlet / habitation (ST Earmark).

rows.qualification_required: Must have passed Intermediate / 12th Class compulsorily.
Intermediate / 12th Class. If candidates with Intermediate / 12th Class qualification are not available, candidates who have passed SSC / 10th Class will be considered.

content_sections.heading: WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Age Limit
content_sections.text: Applicants must be between 35 years and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026. (Note: The official notification specifies a range of 35 years to 35 years).

content_sections.heading: WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises merit marks, special category points, and an interview conducted by the District Selection Committee. Intermediate / 12th Class marks - Maximum merit marks: 70 marks. Special Categories: Widows - 5 marks. Orphans (JJ Act, 2015) - 10 marks. Disabled persons (RPWD Act, 2016) - 5 marks. District Selection Committee Interview - Maximum marks: 10 marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at wdcw.tg.nic.in. Navigate to the online application link for the Kumuram Bheem Asifabad district recruitment. Register and fill out the online application form with required details. Upload scanned copies of all required documents. Submit the application form before 5:00 PM on 23 October 2026. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC Memo (Proof of Date of Birth / Age). Residence certificate issued by Tahsildar within one year (if married outside the village). Intermediate / 12th class marks memo. Certificate of qualification issued by Tahsildar if claiming lower qualification. Special Category certificate (Widows death certificate, Divorce certificate, Orphan certificate under JJ Act, 2015, or Disability certificate).

content_sections.heading: WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications submitted through DWO, CDPO, Prajavani, post, or e-mail will not be considered. Only online applications submitted through the official portal will be accepted. The District Collector and District Magistrate / Collector, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad reserves full rights to cancel, modify, or alter the notification or decisions without assigning reasons. Candidates belonging to SC Group-I, Group-II, and Group-III who previously applied for Group-III reserves need not apply again as per POA.A2 memo dated 14.04.2025; they will be considered automatically, while remaining SC group applicants must submit applications online. Printed copies of the application must be submitted to the respective Gram Panchayat / Mandal offices / Division offices notice board.

faq.question: Q1. What is WCD Kumuram Bheem Asifabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by the Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department of Kumuram Bheem Asifabad to fill 433 Anganwadi Worker and Helper vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 433 vacancies are available, comprising 153 Anganwadi Teacher posts and 280 Anganwadi Aya (Helper) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate / 12th Class compulsorily.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Helper?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate / 12th Class, or SSC / 10th Class if Intermediate candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 35 and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website at wdcw.tg.nic.in before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection criteria?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit marks in Intermediate (up to 70 marks), special category points (Widows, Orphans, Disabled), and a District Selection Committee interview (10 marks).
